## Goal
Make NV02 have exactly one canonical runtime owner and one deploy/startup path so the live process on 127.0.0.1:8799 always runs the exact approved source.

## Confirmed evidence
- #1349 source repair is already merged, but live acceptance failed with RUNTIME_OWNER_DEPLOY_CONFLICT.
- Live PC01 showed source/runtime drift: the file at D:\TigerIQ\Apps\ChromeController\Runtime\direct-cdp-bridge.mjs was older while the process listening on :8799 exposed a newer NV02_ISOLATED_AUTO_CONTINUE health shape.
- Historical Start-Workspace-826 logic explicitly excludes NV02 and points to NV02FollowWatch, while Install-NV02-Continuity expects the Direct-CDP bridge on :8799.
- NV02 continuity state had dispatchesInChat=47, proving long-thread rotation was not converged in live runtime.
- Owner authorized scoped Control Plane maintenance in private chat.

## Required
1. Audit all source-controlled startup/deploy/runtime-owner paths for NV02 and define exactly one canonical owner.
2. Remove or fail-closed any competing legacy path such as NV02FollowWatch when the canonical Direct-CDP bridge owns NV02.
3. Make Install-NV02-Continuity and the workspace/startup contract agree on the same owner and artifact.
4. Add runtime provenance evidence: approved commit/artifact ID + deployed file hash/version + owning process identity.
5. On startup/reboot, refuse stale fallback to Canary1038-R2 or any old runtime when provenance does not match.
6. Preserve the 21 natural continue prompts and 5–10 minute random cadence; NV02 remains execution-only and must not select backlog/P0 itself.
7. Preserve one-browser-mutation-owner, model-profile, auth/security/rate-limit, and current-work-only guards.
8. Add regression tests for duplicate runtime-owner detection, stale-runtime refusal, and exact deploy-source equality.
9. branch -> PR -> exact-head checks -> independent review -> merge.
10. Live acceptance only after PC01 reconnects: start exactly one 8799 owner, verify exact approved source, verify Worker Utility clean, then reversible NV02 canary proves prompt continuation and chat rotation without duplicate dispatch.

## Acceptance
- Exactly one NV02 runtime owner.
- :8799 health identifies the canonical owner and approved source revision.
- Deployed direct-cdp-bridge content/hash matches the approved source artifact.
- Reboot/restart cannot silently fall back to stale runtime.
- 21 continue prompts still work only on the currently assigned job.
- #1349 can then resume and close only with fresh live PC01 evidence.

Do not mutate MAIN directly. Do not use PC01 shell for source engineering.

## OWNER CORRECTION — API FAILOVER 2026-09-21 22:29 +07
- Prior Coding Lane objectives for this same issue are BLOCKED by AUTO_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED:OUTPUT_CONTRACT_EXHAUSTED; do NOT report NV17 as running unless live Coding Lane shows busy=true/current job.
- Re-intake this SAME canonical issue; do not open a duplicate repair issue.
- IMPLEMENTER_ROUTING=PREFER_NV11_THEN_NV12_ANY_HEALTHY_FREE
- EXCLUDE_IMPLEMENTER_NV17=true until its JSON/output-contract failure is separately repaired.
- NV10 is runtime SRE/watchdog only: it may monitor/recover NV02 runtime using existing reversible controls, but MUST NOT edit repository source for this issue.
- Reduce output size: implement sequentially in three bounded source slices under the same mutation owner/branch: (1) installer/startup preserves Core→Controller autopilot + provenance, (2) cancelled/superseded previous-job reconciliation, (3) Windows runtime-evidence atomic persistence serialization/retry. Checkpoint/commit after each slice.
- Each model response must be minimal machine-readable patch output; no long prose payload. If one provider fails output-contract, fail over immediately to the next healthy FREE resource without exhausting the whole objective.
- Keep one mutation owner for apps/chrome-controller/**; reviewer must be independent.
- Owner wants runtime restored continuously in parallel: source repair must not reserve/stop NV02 UI except during bounded live canary after merge.
- REINTAKE_REVISION=20260921T2229+07


## OWNER CORRECTION — PR #1361 INCOMPLETE 2026-09-21 22:36 +07
- PR #1361 - NV02 Canonical Runtime Owner and Deploy Convergence merged, but DOES NOT satisfy the confirmed live RCA/acceptance in this canonical issue.
- Verified missing from PR #1361 diff:
  A. Install-NV02-Continuity still must preserve Core→Controller autopilot instead of forcing autopilot.enabled=false and stateUrl=''.
  B. Cancelled/superseded previous job must reconcile without permanent PREVIOUS_JOB_CANCELLED stop.
  C. Windows runtime-evidence atomic persistence EPERM must be serialized/retried durably.
  D. Runtime provenance must prove deployed source/hash == approved source; an in-process Set is not cross-process duplicate-owner detection.
- DO_NOT_CLOSE=true until A+B+C+D plus reboot/reinstall canary pass.
- REINTAKE_SAME_ISSUE=true; no duplicate issue.
- EXCLUDE_IMPLEMENTER_NV12=true
- EXCLUDE_IMPLEMENTER_NV17=true
- IMPLEMENTER_ROUTING=PREFER_NV11_THEN_ANY_HEALTHY_FREE_EXCEPT_NV12_NV17
- Reviewer must independently verify exact diff against A+B+C+D, not only generic tests.
- Keep patch bounded and machine-readable. One mutation owner for apps/chrome-controller/**.
- REINTAKE_REVISION=20260921T2236+07

Additional root causes proven live:
- Canonical Install-NV02-Continuity.ps1 currently explicitly sets chrome-controller config autopilot.enabled=false and autopilot.stateUrl='', which disables the Core→Controller assignment path even while Core /api/ui-assignment correctly returns GH-1339.
- Re-enabling runtime config with stateUrl=http://127.0.0.1:8794/api/ui-autopilot/snapshot immediately restored Core snapshots into :8798.
- Controller then stopped on stale durable autopilot state lastDispatchedJobId=GH-1232 while Core marks previousJob GH-1232 CANCELLED. Backing up/reconciling this stale state to fresh IDLE allowed exact same Core snapshot to dispatch GH-1339 successfully.
- Live acceptance after reconciliation: GH-1339 is WORKING in NV02, Controller :8798 online, Direct-CDP :8799 online, Core :8795 and Coding Lane :8797 healthy.
- PersistEvidence EPERM atomic rename failures remain and must be fixed/serialized/retried durably in source; do not rely on the current runtime workaround.

Required source acceptance must therefore include:
A. Installer/startup preserves Core→Controller dispatch configuration instead of disabling it.
B. Cancelled/superseded previous job reconciles safely without permanent PREVIOUS_JOB_CANCELLED stop.
C. runtime-evidence atomic persistence is serialized/retried on Windows and cannot crash/poison controller state.
D. reboot/reinstall canary reproduces the currently recovered live topology without manual state surgery.
